newsitem.title: TANZANIA: New BA Entebbe, Dar es Salaam air cargo route.
newsitem.headline: New BA Entebbe, Dar es Salaam air cargo route.

text.p: British Airways Plc will launch in October a new air cargo service from London to Dar es Salaam via Entebbe in southern Uganda, BA's Tanzania manager Mark Jones told Reuters.

"Tanzania is growing, no doubt about this, new buildings are being constructed all over the city. At the same time Uganda has also been growing and it's come to the time where it deserves to get a direct flight, so from October we'll be changing the route," Jones said.

He said that from October BA will fly twice a week London-Entebbe-Dar es Salaam and return, instead of routing all the Entebbe and Dar es Salaam-bound flights via the Kenyan capital of Nairobi, the main air cargo hub for East Africa.
At present BA have three weekly flights to Dar es Salaam via Nairobi, in addition to several flights to Entebbe -- also via Nairobi.
While the new route will cut the number of BA flights to Tanzania, this will only be temporary and due to a lack of the right sized aircraft, Jones said.

He said that from February 1998 BA will fly the new Entebbe-Dar es Salaam route at least three times a week. "Nairobi takes the lion's share of both passengers and cargo...but the new route will offer a lot more cargo potential for Dar es Salaam and Entebbe," Jones added.

He said Entebbe in particular had a big export volume of fresh fish from Lake Victoria, while from Tanzania cut flowers, seafood and mineral samples from the country's rapidly growing mining industry in the northwestern Mwanza region could be developed to a profitable air cargo business. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
